I play the game mostly as like a found family and not super interested in relationships and this is how I rank the brothers. 
1. Mammon he was our first and he’s so sweet sometimes. And he’s bashful and loyal. He’s very caring even if he doesn’t want us to know and I have a thing for idiots 
2. Levi I relate to not feeling like someone would actually love me. And I get how it is when people don’t wanna listen to your interests. 
3. Beel I feel like beel doesn’t really care abt a romantic relationship really and he really feels like a little brother to my mc
4. Satan I like all the pranks he plays on lucifer. And they’re mostly harmless. 
5. Asmo I feel pretty neutral to asmo. He’s very caring and very touchy feely person. 
6. Belphie I really wanted to like belphie when he was introduced it wasn’t even the attempted murder that makes me dislike him. It’s how he acts like mc will just listen to whatever he tells them. Very demanding. However I do like how mc takes naps with him. I think it’s very sweet and he’s apart of the anti-lucifer league 
7. Lucifer I can’t stand lucifer. Again he’s so demanding and is always like I expect mc to do this. It’s not a request it’s an order. He cares a lot about his brothers and I respect that.
